sources.title: Login to Disney+ | Login or Signup
sources.snippet: Log in to access Disney+ and explore a wide range of movies, TV series, and exclusive originals.

sources.title: Log in to Disney+ | Login or Sign up
sources.snippet: Log in to Disney+ with your MyDisney account. If you don’t have one, you will be prompted to create an account before signing up.

sources.title: Entrar no Disney+ | Entrar ou Assinar
sources.snippet: Entre no Disney+ com a sua conta MyDisney. Se você não tiver conta, precisará criar uma conta antes de assinar.

sources.title: Iniciar sesión en Disney+ | Acceder o suscribirte
sources.snippet: Es necesario que inicies sesión en Disney+ con tu cuenta de MyDisney. En caso de no tener una, recibirás indicaciones para crearla …

sources.title: Logge dich bei Disney+ ein | Einloggen oder Registrieren
sources.snippet: Logge dich mit deinem MyDisney-Konto in Disney+ ein. Falls du noch kein Konto hast, wirst du aufgefordert, es vor der Registrierung …
